25 Which group of electromagnetic waves is arranged in order from shortest wavelength to longest
wavelength?
A
radio waves  visible light  gamma rays
B
visible light  microwaves  infrared
C
visible light  ultraviolet  X-rays
D
X-rays  infrared  microwaves

hints: Recall the full electromagnetic spectrum in wavelength order starting with gamma rays and X-rays at the short-wavelength end and ending with microwaves and radio waves at the long-wavelength end.
Notice the question asks for shortest wavelength to longest wavelength, so wavelength must increase from left to right and frequency must decrease.
Compare the positions of X-rays, infrared and microwaves with visible light in the middle to check which group increases steadily in wavelength.
walkthrough: Recall the electromagnetic spectrum in order of increasing wavelength: gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet, visible light, infrared, microwaves, radio waves.
This means shortest wavelength also means highest frequency because $c = f\lambda$ with $c = 3.0 \times 10^8 \text{ m s}^{-1}$ constant.
Check group A: radio waves are longest and gamma rays are shortest, so it decreases in wavelength.
Check groups B and C: visible light to microwaves to infrared swaps infrared and microwaves, and visible light to ultraviolet to X-rays decreases in wavelength.
Check X-rays to infrared to microwaves: X-rays are on the short-wavelength side of visible light, while infrared then microwaves are successively on the long-wavelength side.
Wavelength therefore increases left to right, from about $10^{-10} \text{ m}$ to $10^{-5} \text{ m}$ to $10^{-2} \text{ m}$. This is option D

A.explanation: Radio waves have the longest wavelengths in the spectrum and gamma rays have the shortest, so this order is longest to shortest.

B.explanation: Visible light is shorter than both microwaves and infrared, but infrared is shorter than microwaves, so the last two are reversed.

C.explanation: X-rays are shorter than ultraviolet which is shorter than visible light, so this group runs from longest to shortest.

D.explanation: X-rays have wavelength around $10^{-10} \text{ m}$, infrared around $10^{-5} \text{ m}$ and microwaves around $10^{-2} \text{ m}$, which is increasing wavelength.
